tokenName: Citizens Economic Empowerment Commission PPP Token
description: PPP token issued by Citizens Economic Empowerment Commission for a major public infrastructure project in Zambia. Token holders participate in revenue sharing under a concession agreement.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia PPP Act; National Infrastructure Tokenisation Policy 2024

tokenName: Citizens Economic Empowerment Commission Development Bond Token
description: Government development bond token issued by Citizens Economic Empowerment Commission. Proceeds finance social infrastructure projects including schools, hospitals and water sanitation in Zambia.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Public Finance Management Act; Central Bank Bond Tokenisation Framework

tokenName: Citizens Economic Empowerment Commission Project Milestone Token
description: Milestone token issued by Citizens Economic Empowerment Commission for verified completion of government-funded projects in Zambia. Each token represents one completed and independently verified project milestone.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Government Contracting Act; Digital Project Finance Rules
